messages:
sam_support: Heads-up — customer acme-inc (acct: 12345) says Azure accelerator credits were granted (email received 2025-05-09) but their balance is still 0 in our console. Azure order id: 0xA7C4D3, tenant: 1111-2222-3333. They re-linked marketplace and refreshed, no change. Can billing take a look?

nisha_billing: Got it. Do we have the subscription id and the partner account used to grant the credits? Any webhook failures in our logs?

sam_support: Subscription id: sub-7890. Partner was "AzureAccelerator" via partner portal. I checked the entitlement webhook consumer logs for that tenant — saw a 404 on our /entitlements endpoint right when Azure sent the grant. Snippet: 
```
curl -v -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/entitlements -d '{"tenant":"1111-2222-3333","order":"0xA7C4D3"}'
< HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
< {"error":"no_account_mapping"}
```
I also saw one stack trace from entitlement-processor: 
```
KeyError: 'partner_customer_id'
  File "/app/processor.py", line 212, in handle_grant
    partner_id = payload['partner_customer_id']
```

maria_eng: Hmm looks like the payload from Azure is missing the partner_customer_id for this tenant which our mapping layer uses to link to account 12345. Two possibilities: 1) Azure didn't include partner metadata for this grant, or 2) our mapping service recently changed keys and failed to fallback.

manual steps to repro/confirm: 1) run entitlement-processor locally pointing at the recorded payload 2) run requeue for that order id 3) check billing ledger after entitlement applied.

ian_devrel: Sam — can you try the reconcile tool I put in tools/ last week, it will show mapping hits: 
```
./tools/reconcile_entitlements --tenant 1111-2222-3333 --order 0xA7C4D3 --dry-run
```
It prints the mapping decision and where it stops.

sam_support: Ran it (dry-run). Output: 
"no mapping for partner_customer_id -> falling back to tenant_link -> tenant_link missing -> enqueue for manual review"
So the tool confirms mapping fallback failed. Full output pasted here: 
```
[INFO] starting reconcile for tenant 1111-2222-3333 order 0xA7C4D3
[DEBUG] payload keys: ['tenant','order','grantee']
[WARN] partner_customer_id not present
[DEBUG] tried tenant link lookup -> none
[INFO] enqueueing manual linkage job id=job-5544
[OK] dry-run complete, no ledger updates applied
```

nisha_billing: Thanks. That explains the 404 earlier. Next step is to run the manual linkage job for job-5544 and then apply entitlement to the billing ledger. Applying to ledger requires an admin call (and audit). Can you open an internal billing ticket and request manual apply + include the job id and customer account?

sam_support: Ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-4312 — summary: "Apply Azure accelerator grant for acme-inc tenant 1111-2222-3333; job job-5544". I added the curl outputs and dry-run log.

maria_eng: One more ask — can you grab entitlement-processor service logs around 2025-05-09 14:12 UTC (when Azure emailed grant). I want the full payload to confirm whether Azure omitted partner id vs our parser dropping it. If parser dropped it, safe to reprocess.

sam_support: Pasted the raw event to the ticket (sensitive fields redacted). Looks like payload has grantee.email but no partner_customer_id. 

eng_oncall_bot: deploy-notice: entitlement-processor v2.7.3 deployed to prod at 2025-05-10T03:00:12Z by maria_eng :rocket:

maria_eng: That deploy included a small change to strict-validate partner_customer_id presence, which might cause older grants with missing fields to fail earlier. If we reprocess after we run a one-off that adds a fallback mapping (tenant->account), it should succeed.

nisha_billing: I'll own the ledger apply once engineering confirms the job completed. Billing will need the audit string — please add the admin user who will run the apply to BILL-4312 and note the reason. Also confirm the amount of credits to apply (customer says $10k accelerator).

sam_support: Added admin user: billing_ops_julia. Confirmed credit amount: 10000 USD (accelerator grant). Added to the ticket.

maria_eng: Plan: engineering will run the manual linkage job (job-5544), reprocess the event, confirm entitlement-processor logs show success, then @nisha_billing will call admin apply endpoint. I will run the linkage now and update the ticket.

(10 minutes later)
maria_eng: linkage job completed, reprocessed event. entitlement-processor log: 
```
[INFO] processed grant order 0xA7C4D3 -> account 12345
[INFO] created entitlement ent-9987 credit_amount 10000
[DEBUG] queued ledger apply ent-9987 -> awaiting admin apply
```

nisha_billing: Great — I'm running the apply now. Curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://internal-admin.redwood/apply-entitlement \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"entitlement_id":"ent-9987","approved_by":"billing_ops_julia", "reason":"accelerator grant application"}'
```

nisha_billing: Apply returned 200 and ledger shows credit applied. Customer balance updated. Sam — can you confirm with acme-inc?

sam_support: Confirmed with customer — balance now shows 10000 USD of accelerator credits. Customer happy and sent :tada:. I updated BILL-4312 with postmortem notes and flagged that deploy made parser stricter; engineering to add a graceful fallback for historical grants.

maria_eng: Filed ENG-1429 to add fallback and add a unit-test for payloads missing partner_customer_id.

sam_support: Closing this thread — follow-ups in BILL-4312 and ENG-1429. Thanks all :heart:
